verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Transform MCP server that links AI tools to Transform so they can ingest local files and return partitioned, enriched, chunked, and embedded output. The docs list compatible clients (Codex CLI, Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Devin, JetBrains), offer a Claude-driven quickstart, and the llms.txt probe points to MCP server guidance. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as claimed, and detail on the exposed tool surface, auth, and setup; the documented scope also appears limited to local-file ingestion rather than full workflow and job management.
